minutes_text:
CITY COUNCIL
MINUTES
CITY OF BALDWIN PARK
CITY COUNCIL
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 19, 2008
7:00 p.m. COUNCIL CHAMBERS
14403 E. Pacific Avenue
Baldwin Park
Manuel Lozano, Mayor
Anthony J. Bejarano, Mayor Pro Tem Marlen Garcia, Monica Garcia, Ricardo Pacheco, Council Members
Maria Contreras, City Treasurer Susan Rubio, City Clerk
The CITY COUNCIL of the City of Baldwin Park met in REGULAR SESSION at the above time and place.
CALL TO ORDER
INVOCATION
Led by Mayor Pro Tem Bejarano
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ANNOUNCEMENTS
Mayor Lozano closed in memory of Jose Tascon; Council member Marlen Garcia closed on behalf of Maria Urena, long-time resident who was very actively involved in the community; Council member Pacheco closed on behalf of Olivia Reyes, long-time resident.
ROLL CALL
Present: Council member Marlen Garcia, Council member Monica Garcia, Council member Pacheco, Mayor Pro Tem Bejarano, Mayor Lozano.
Absent: None.
Also Present: Chief Executive Officer Vijay Singhal, City Attorney Joseph W. Pannone, Director of Recreation & Community Services Manuel Carrillo Jr., Community Development Manager Marc Castagnola, Director of Public Works William Galvez, Chief of Police Lili Hadsell, City Treasurer Contreras, City Clerk Rubio, Deputy City Clerk Nieto.
PROCLAMATIONS, COMMENDATIONS & PRESENTATIONS
Recognition of Jackie Breceda for her participation as official announcer for the Baldwin Park Anniversary Parade
Mayor Lozano, joined by the Council, Treasurer & Clerk presented Ms. Breceda with a plaque in recognition of her participation at the Baldwin Park Anniversary Parade
Council member Pacheco recognized School Board members Jack White & Christine Lucero, Water Board Members Al Contreras, Margarita Vargas and David Sano, Planning Commission Chair Jim Dexter, West Covina Council Member Mike Touhey and Irwindale Council member Mark Breceda
Mayor Lozano announcement that Bisno Development will no longer be moving forward with the proposed downtown redevelopment project due.
PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS
Thomas Carey , resident commented about current financial issues in the country and other issues.
Margaret Salonisen , resident announced the upcoming Baldwin Park Women’s Club Bazaar and invited the Council and the public to attend. On behalf of the Chamber of Commerce, she announced their upcoming toy drive
Cruz Baca Sembello , resident commented about the announcement regarding the proposed redevelopment project. She stated that the residents were working on a plan and expressed her desire to work with the Council.
Greg Tuttle , business owner served recall papers on Council members Marlen Garcia, Monica Garcia and Mayor Pro Tem Bejarano. He commented on past statements made by the Council regarding his leaving meetings early. Inquired about what will happen with the funds Bisno Development has already invested in the city. Also commented on the filing against the city from CARA.
Andrew Morales Miramontes , resident commented about the announcement regarding the proposed redevelopment project and expressed his continued support of it
Magda Torrellas , resident commented about the announcement regarding the proposed downtown redevelopment and thanked Bisno Development for the contributions they made to the community.
Ricardo Monroy & John Declercq , Bisno Development read a statement regarding the proposed downtown redevelopment project. They thanked the Council, staff and residents for the work that they had done.
Fidel Vargas , resident thanked Public Works Director Galvez for responding to a recent request he had made regarding a traffic signal. He further thanked Bisno Development for the contributions they made to the community
Andrea Valenzuela , resident/BPHS student expressed her support of Bisno Development and the proposed downtown redevelopment project
Public Communications were closed at 7:43 p.m.
Council member Pacheco commented about the community involvement with the proposed downtown project and expressed the importance of the residents and the Council working together. This provides the community and Council to start with a clean slate. He further thanked Bisno Development for their contributions to the community.
Council member Marlen Garcia commented about Bisno Development’s suspension of the proposed downtown project. She spoke about the effects of the current financial difficulties and how not only are businesses effected but families as well. Stated that the Council was building a community for the future of Baldwin Park and the project was paused, not completely stopped. She further thanked Bob Bisno and Bisno Development for their investment in the city.
Mayor Pro Tem Bejarano thanked Bob Bisno and his team for being true corporate citizens and their participation at many community event. He commented about the current economic situation and how it is effecting everyone. He expressed pride with the Council’s actions taken on the project and encouraged those in the community to seek resolutions to the economic issues and put it in a positive message to improve the city.
Council member Monica Garcia acknowledged the efforts of Bob Bisno and his team and thanked them for encouraging the council to look at possibilities, not limitations for the community. The city will be stronger based on this experience, for the next round. She also acknowledged the Mayor and Council for putting themselves out there in support of the project. She encouraged the community to have hope.
Mayor Lozano thanked Bob Bisno and his staff. He commented about the past redevelopment projects that have been a part of the city. He spoke about the energy and excitement that the youth have for change and opportunity in their city.
He further addressed the comments of speaker Tuttle.
Council member Monica Garcia responded to comments made regarding the spending of taxpayer money and stated that at the end of the fiscal year, Baldwin Park had a surplus, not a deficit.
CONSENT CALENDAR
Motion: Approve CONSENT CALENDAR
Moved by Mayor Lozano, seconded by Council member Marlen Garcia.
1. WARRANTS AND DEMANDS
Staff Report
City Council received and filed.
2. PROPOSED RECOGNITIONS BY THE MAYOR AND CITY COUNCIL FOR THE PERIOD OF NOVEMBER 3, 2008 THROUGH NOVEMBER 18, 2008
Staff Report
City Council approved the preparation and presentation of the plaques, proclamations and certificates as outlined in the staff report.
3. MINUTES
Staff Report
City Council approved the minutes of the special and regular meetings of November 5, 2008.
4. MONTHLY FINANCIAL REPORT
Staff Report
City Council received and filed the monthly financial report for the period ended September 2008.
5. 2nd READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 1316
Staff Report
City Council waived further reading, read by title only adopted on second reading Ordinance No. 1316 entitled, "AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK MODIFYING SECTION 153.315.5 OF THE BALDWIN PARK MUNICIPAL CODE TO REDUCE THE AREA SUBJECT TO THE REDEVELOPMENT PROJECT AREA OVERLAY BY MODIFYING THE NORTHERN BOUNDARY; CASE NO.: AZC-162; LOCATION: 4300-4390 MAINE AVENUE (BOTH ODD AND EVEN ADDRESSES;) APPLICANT: ELODIA MUNOZ DE VAZQUEZ AND RONALD G. PEREZ."
6. NATIONAL LEAGUE OF CITIES PRESCRIPTION DISCOUNT CARD PROGRAM
Staff Report
City Council authorized the Chief Executive Officer to enroll the city in the National League of Cities Prescription Discount Program.
7. AUTHORIZATION TO PROCEED WITH ADVERTISEMENT OF A BID PACKAGE FOR PROPOSALS FOR THE DESIGN AND INSTALLATION OF AN UPGRADE OF AN UNDERGROUND FUEL STORAGE TANKS VENT SYSTEM TO A HEALEY ENHANCED VAPOR RECOVERY PHASE II SYSTEM
Staff Report
City Council authorized staff to advertise the bid package for the design and installation of an upgrade of an underground fuel storage tanks vent system to a Healey Enhanced Vapor Recovery Phase II system.
8. RESOLUTION RECOGNIZING THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH AS THE ORGANIZATION RESPONSIBLE FOR LOCAL ENFORCEMENT OF ALL LAWS AND REGULATIONS PERTAINING TO THE MANAGEMENT OF SOLID WASTE WITHIN THE CITY
Staff Report
City Council waived further reading, read by title only and adopted Resolution No. 2008-071 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH, SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT PROGRAM, AS THE LOCAL ENFORCEMENT AGENCY RESPONSIBLE FOR ENFORCING ALL LAWS AND REGULATIONS PERTAINING TO THE MANAGEMENT OF SOLID WASTE WITHIN THE CITY."
9. RESOLUTION ACCEPTING SUPPLEMENTARY PROPOSITION 1B FUNDS FROM THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE TO BE USED ON ELIGIBLE TRANSPORTATION PROJECTS IN THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK
Staff Report
City Council waived further reading, read by title only and adopted Resolution No. 2008-070 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK, CALIFORNIA, ACCEPTING SUPPLEMENTARY PROPOSITION 1B FUNDS FROM THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA FOR USE ON ELIGIBLE TRANSPORTATION PROJECTS WITHIN THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK."
CITY COUNCIL/ CITY CLERK / CITY TREASURER / STAFF REQUESTS & COMMUNICATIONS
Request by Mayor Lozano for discussion on the following:
-Request for Council discussion and direction to staff to erect a War Memorial in front of City Hall in the memory of three Baldwin Park fallen soldiers in current conflicts; and
-Request for Council discussion regarding speed bumps in the city
Mayor Lozano requested that the names of Atanacio Haro Marin; Rudy Salas and Gabriel Figueroa be placed on the proposed war memorial. He deferred discussion on his second item (speed bumps) to January.
Request by Council member Monica Garcia and Mayor Pro Tem Bejarano for discussion on the following:
Request for discussion and direction to staff to bring forward a staff report for appointment of an ad-hoc Council committee to promote greater economic opportunities for Baldwin Park youth and residents, through workforce, higher education and career development programs
Council member Monica Garcia commented on the request item, stating that it would be an "umbrella" committee that would report back to the Council on its findings and recommendations. She provided some examples of programs and opportunities.
Mayor Pro Tem Bejarano commented on the positive impacts that this type of committee would have and the benefits that it could potentially bring to the community and businesses. Stated that youth are the city's greatest asset.
Council member Pacheco stated that a past committee also involved the school district and requested that it be incorporated into this committee. He also requested that they involve the adult school in this program. It was further requested that staff bring back a report on what the prior committee did and revamp that. He wished Mayor Pro Tem Bejarano and Council member Moncia Garcia success with the committee.
Council member Monica Garcia stated that they would report on a regular basis. Council member Pacheco commended her for her efforts.
Council member Marlen Garcia expressed her support of the committee. She announced an award that the city received regarding these types of programs and thanked Director Carrillo for he and his staff’s efforts with these program. She further acknowledged the school district and Los Angeles Universal Preschool for the opening of new pre-schools in the city.
Council member Marlen Garcia also spoke about the collaboration between the city and other agencies for the point of dispense (POD) event at Sierra Vista High School and thanked all that participated. She acknowledged Baldwin Park Police Captain Mike Taylor and Lt. Joe Cowan for their participation.
ADJOURNMENT
There being no other matters for discussion the meeting was adjourned in memory of Jose Tascon, Maria Urena and Olivia Reyes at 8:20 p.m.
Approved as presented by the Council at their meeting held December 3, 2008.
Laura M. Nieto
Deputy City Clerk
